title: The kbmon-pane mod shows kbmon live in a pane and gives the agent only the receipt
goal: a plugin of function hooks in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane loads in every session of the clone and does nothing in a session whose session.start says isInteractive false; in an interactive session it opens a kbmon pane that a 60-second timer fills with kbmon.py --once at the pane's columns, finding Python as python3, python or py -3; after a resize it lays the pane out again at the new width within one refresh; /kbmon opens the pane again; a toast tells the person when the alert set changes; the agent gets the kbmon.py --receipt line as one appended user-role row at session start and another only when the fingerprint changes; the pane adds no constant CPU load (operator, 2026-10-19): its timer never starts kbmon.py --once while the last run is still going, and one refresh costs under 6 CPU seconds

run:
import shutil,subprocess as s,sys
c=shutil.which('claude')
if not c:
    print('claude is not on PATH');sys.exit(1)
p=s.run([c,'plugin','validate','.claude/skills/kbmon-pane'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);o=p.stdout+p.stderr
need=['session.start','ui.render{component=Pane','command.run{command=kbmon}','$.process.run','$.session.append','$.ui.toast','$.clock.every','$.ui.open']
miss=[n for n in need if n not in o]
if p.returncode!=0 or 'Validation passed' not in o or miss:
    print(o[-1200:]);print('missing:',miss);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: the mod validates and hooks and calls what the goal names')

import glob,sys
t=''.join(open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/**/*.ts*',recursive=True))
need=['isInteractive','--receipt','--once','bodyColumns',"'-3'",'60_000']
miss=[n for n in need if n not in t]
print('missing:',miss) if miss else print('ok');sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

import glob,re,sys,subprocess,resource,time
src="".join(open(f,encoding="utf-8").read() for f in glob.glob(".claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/**/*.ts*",recursive=True))
if not src:
    print("no kbmon-pane hooks yet");sys.exit(1)
if not re.search(r"(inFlight|running|busy|pending)",src):
    print("the pane timer has no guard against starting kbmon.py --once while the last run is still going");sys.exit(1)
t=time.time();subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--once"],capture_output=True)
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);cpu=u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime
print("one pane refresh (kbmon.py --once) cpu seconds:",round(cpu,1),"wall",round(time.time()-t,1))
sys.exit(0 if cpu<6 else 1)

clauses.clause: a plugin of function hooks in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane loads in every session of the clone and does nothing in a session whose session.start says isInteractive false
in an interactive session it opens a kbmon pane that a 60-second timer fills with kbmon.py --once at the pane's columns, finding Python as python3, python or py -3
after a resize it lays the pane out again at the new width within one refresh
a toast tells the person when the alert set changes
the agent gets the kbmon.py --receipt line as one appended user-role row at session start and another only when the fingerprint changes
the pane adds no constant CPU load (operator, 2026-10-19): its timer never starts kbmon.py --once while the last run is still going
one refresh costs under 6 CPU seconds

gates.question: How often does the pane run kbmon.py --receipt: on every 60-second refresh, or only after a refresh whose alert rows differ from the last one's (one run per minute instead of two; the fingerprint cannot move while the alert rows are the same)?
options: only when the --once alert rows change
gates.recommendation: only when the --once alert rows change
gates.answer: only when the --once alert rows change

gates.question: How does the pane lay itself out again after a resize: only at the next 60-second refresh, or also one second after the resize settles through the same guarded refresh (the pane is clipped for less than a minute, a drag costs one run)?
options: also one second after the resize settles
gates.recommendation: also one second after the resize settles
gates.answer: also one second after the resize settles

gates.question: Does the session-start receipt row wait for the first kbmon run at session.start (holding the first prompt for several seconds), or does the first run start 1.5 seconds later, not awaited, once the pane's first drawing has given its width?
options: wait for the run at session.start
first run 1.5 seconds after session.start, not awaited
gates.recommendation: first run 1.5 seconds after session.start, not awaited

notes: Plan 2026-10-19 (operator choices): the receipt comes from the mod, not settings hooks, since session.start's isInteractive (false for -p and the SDK) is the one documented headless signal; the mod lives in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane and loads with no install and no settings change. Prototype in the discovery session (scratchpad, --plugin-dir): the pane docked as a sidebar at 170 columns, clipped at once on a resize and was laid out again at the new width after one kbmon run (about 20 s); the demo agent quoted only the receipt row, nothing of the pane. Checks: claude plugin validate and a read of the module; no check runs the mod, since claude plugin test needs a *.test.ts file, which the operator ruled out (D-6kei5o2z, D-2tq4fhgs), and a live session makes a model call. The mods API is early access (bundled reference, Claude Code 2.1.290; this host runs 2.1.303).
